segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the scope for the renewal and the added seats before I send the order form through deal desk.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 42 seats today, and we want to move to 55 starting May 1. Same admin package as last year.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 55 seats, May 1 start. The current term ends April 30, so this would be a clean 12-month renewal through April 30 next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Can you keep the invoice annual? Finance asked that we avoid quarterly billing if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, annual invoice is fine. Based on the pricing sheet, the total is $48,950 before tax for the year. That includes the 13 added seats prorated? Sorry, not prorated, since they start with the new term.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the services hours we discussed, the eight hours for workflow review, are those included or separate?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Separate line item. It’s $1,800 for the eight-hour block, scheduled within the first 60 days. So combined total would be $50,750 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fine. We need the purchase order number on the invoice. It’ll be PO-4176. Can you put that on the order form too?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I’ll add PO-4176 to the billing notes and the order form. Anything needed on contract terms, or same as the current agreement?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Same terms. Our legal team already approved the renewal language last year, so as long as it’s not changed, we’re good.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send the order form today. Once it’s signed, the billing tool will generate the invoice within one business day, and your go-live for the added seats will be May 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send it to me and copy Mark in finance, and I’ll route it for signature by Friday.
